fields.Name: UI: Agent Channels - Participants Only
fields.Description: Restricts Agent Channel visibility and updates to active participants in MJ: Agent Channel Participants or administrative roles (Owner, System Administrator, Administrator, Admin, Administration).
fields.FilterText: ([ID] IN (SELECT [acp].[AgentChannelID] FROM [__mj].[AgentChannelParticipant] [acp] WHERE [acp].[UserID] = '{{UserID}}') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] [u] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[UserRole] [ur] ON [ur].[UserID] = [u].[ID] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[Role] [r] ON [r].[ID] = [ur].[RoleID] WHERE [u].[ID] = '{{UserID}}' AND (LTRIM(RTRIM([u].[Type])) = 'Owner' OR [r].[Name] IN ('System Administrator', 'Administrator', 'Admin', 'Administration'))))

fields.Name: UI: Agent Channel Participants - Participants Only
fields.Description: Restricts Agent Channel Participant visibility and updates to users enrolled in the same Agent Channel or administrative roles.
fields.FilterText: ([AgentChannelID] IN (SELECT [acp].[AgentChannelID] FROM [__mj].[AgentChannelParticipant] [acp] WHERE [acp].[UserID] = '{{UserID}}') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] [u] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[UserRole] [ur] ON [ur].[UserID] = [u].[ID] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[Role] [r] ON [r].[ID] = [ur].[RoleID] WHERE [u].[ID] = '{{UserID}}' AND (LTRIM(RTRIM([u].[Type])) = 'Owner' OR [r].[Name] IN ('System Administrator', 'Administrator', 'Admin', 'Administration'))))
